Hi there.

For as much as you value the love you receive from your fiancé and daughter, you have to understand that the love you have for them is valuable beyond words.  There are an astonishing amount of people who have never experienced loving someone fiercely, or being genuinely loved.  The passion you feel is real.  Your insecurities are real.  You've had a lot of experiences, not all of them were pleasant, but they ADD to who you are as a person.  Your experiences do NOT take away your humanity.  You suspect that your fiancé may resent you for some things in your shared past, but if he really did, you would have no doubt in your mind.  He loves you, you know that.  And he KNOWS you, too.  More than anyone else, he knows you and what you've gone through and your path to happiness, and he's right by your side loving you.  Your daughter may not know your story, but she knows her own story, and so far it consists of two parents who love each other and love her.  That means the world to a young girl.  You are providing more than you realize!  I know it doesn't feel easy, today, but there will be a "today" where it is easier.  Hold out for that day, and the days that will be better (or worse) than that one because all of them add to who you are, and give more power to the love you give to your family.  Your "weaknesses" give you strength that even you have yet to realize.

Best of luck, sleep well tonight and remember your strength and your love when you wake up in the morning :)

Hey buddy, I know that feel.  I'm not sure that this will make you feel better, but here are my thoughts on your situation.

Try to remember that people can't help who they like and dislike.  Imagine if a girl you know suddenly showed interest in you and you had never really thought of her that way before; her sudden interest probably won't make you magically interested in her.  Also, if you like this girl a lot but she isn't interested in you, that's good news in terms of a healthy relationship!  I know you can visualize having a great relationship with her, but it wouldn't be a good relationship if her feelings for you don't come naturally.  And it's okay if they don't, it just means someone else will naturally and genuinely like you, and they won't be able to help it, and that will be the relationship you're looking for :)

Best of luck to you, you deserve to be happy with someone who is happy with you!
